crop_image_by_bbox: crop an image using center and scale to extract a person bounding box region
transform_pixel_coords: transform pixel coordinates between image reference frames using get_transform and transform
flip_keypoints_and_pose: flip keypoints and SMPL pose parameters for data augmentation using flip_kp and flip_pose
compute_bbox_from_keypoints: compute bounding box center and scale from 2D keypoints or openpose JSON detections
process_image_for_model: process and normalize an image with keypoints or bbox into a PyTorch tensor for model input
